descriptions: memcpy writes sig_len bytes to out (shared output buffer) but the short-buffer check is conditional (only when params[3].value.b == 0). When value.b != 0, there is no effective guard ensuring out_len >= sig_len before the copy, so an REE-controlled undersized output buffer can be overrun.

memcpy(out, sig, sig_len) writes sig_len bytes into out (params[1].memref.buffer). The only short-buffer guard is conditional on params[3].value.b == 0, so when value.b != 0 the copy can proceed even if out_len < sig_len, causing an out-of-bounds write into shared memory.
